title: Adaptive Reparametrized Time for Score-Based Diffusion Sampling
abstract: arXiv:2607.02137v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study timestep allocation for score-based diffusion sampling, where a learned reverse-time dynamics is discretized on a finite grid. Uniform and hand-crafted schedules are standard choices, but they rely on fixed prescriptions and can therefore be suboptimal. To address this limitation, we propose Adaptive Reparameterized Time (ART), a continuous-time control formulation that learns a time change by treating the speed of the sampling clock as the control, so that a uniform grid on the learned clock induces adaptive timesteps in the original diffusion time. Based on a leading-order Euler error surrogate, ART provides a principled objective for allocating timesteps along the sampling trajectory. To solve this deterministic control problem, we introduce ART-RL, an auxiliary randomized formulation with Gaussian policies that turns schedule learning into a continuous-time reinforcement learning problem. translated_title: 面向基于分数扩散采样的自适应重参数化时间
translated_abstract: 我们研究基于分数的扩散采样中的时间步分配问题，其中学习到的逆向时间动力学需要在有限网格上进行离散化。均匀调度和手工设计的调度是标准选择，但它们依赖于固定的预设方案，因此可能是次优的。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了自适应重参数化时间，这是一种连续时间控制形式，通过将采样时钟的速度视为控制量来学习时间变换，从而使得在学习到的时钟上的均匀网格能够映射为原始扩散时间中的自适应时间步。基于一阶欧拉误差代理，ART为沿采样轨迹分配时间步提供了一个有原则的目标函数。为了求解这个确定性控制问题，我们引入了ART-RL，这是一种辅助性的随机化形式，采用高斯策略将调度学习转化为连续时间强化学习问题。我们证明了该随机化过程（原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 提出自适应重参数化时间方法，通过将采样时钟速度作为控制量并结合连续时间强化学习（ART-RL），自适应地为扩散采样分配时间步，克服了均匀和手工设计调度的次优性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Adaptive Reparameterized Time (ART), which treats the sampling clock speed as a control variable and leverages continuous-time reinforcement learning (ART-RL) to adaptively allocate timesteps for score-based diffusion sampling, overcoming the suboptimality of uniform and hand-crafted schedules.
